description: A woman seen from behind, in a dark jacket, long dark skirt and a dark flat-topped hat, raises her right hand in front of a wooden desk that holds a gilded box, a book and a rolled paper. The setting is a wood-panelled chamber with a spectator gallery above and rows of men in dark suits and bow ties seated below, all lit by a shaft of light from above. The era cues are early 20th-century suits and interior, with no legible letters or numbers, no frame, and no gore.
